title: Uncertain Tax Positions - FIN 48 (ASC 740-10)
learning_objectives: Apply two-step recognition and measurement process

content.definition: Tax position is taken in tax return (or expected to be taken) where outcome is uncertain and may not be sustained upon IRS examination

step_1_recognition.test: More likely than not (>50%) that position will be sustained based on technical merits

step_2_measurement.measure_at: Largest amount of benefit that is >50% likely to be realized
step_2_measurement.cumulative_probability: Sum probabilities of outcomes until >50% reached

example.step_1: 60% chance position sustained → More likely than not → Recognize (pass step 1)
example.journal_entry: DR Income Tax Receivable (or reduce payable) $80K, CR Income Tax Benefit $80K. Unrecognized benefit: $20K.

interest_and_penalties.accounting_policy_election: Classify as component of income tax expense OR as interest/other expense

disclosure_requirements: Reconciliation of beginning/ending unrecognized tax benefits
Amounts that, if recognized, would affect ETR
Positions for which substantial change reasonably possible within 12 months
cpa_exam_tips: Step 1: >50% sustainable? Step 2: Largest amount >50% realizable
Separately track recognized vs. unrecognized benefits

key_points: Two steps: Recognition (>50% sustainable), Measurement (largest amount >50% realizable)
Disclosure of uncertain tax positions required
